title: REQ · Git writes go through an interface wrapping the Git CLI with a bot identity
summary: A Committer interface with a CLI implementation using the configured bot identity.
description: Context: contributions must be committed to Git. Desired behavior: gitrepo.Committer interface with a CLI implementation that runs git add and git commit with -c user.name/user.email set from the bot config via an injectable command runner. Expected result: tests mock the runner. Why: credentials never leave the backend and tests need no Git.
acceptance_criteria: Given a CLI committer, when Commit runs, then it executes git add -- <path> then git commit with the bot name and email in the working dir
Given the runner fails on add, when Commit runs, then commit is not executed and the error is returned
Given an empty path list or a path with .., when Commit runs, then an error is returned and no command runs

in_scope: A Committer interface with a CLI implementation using the configured bot identity.
preserve: Existing player session handlers in backend/internal/player

technical_constraints: Go 1.22, chi router, no database; persistent data lives in Git as Markdown/YAML
